title: ORBITAL CHOIR
tagline: Four clocks. One sky. A constellation you can hear.
help: Four melodic orbits have cycles of 5, 7, 11 and 13 steps. Tap a phase button to rotate that orbit against the others. All notes follow the changing harmony. The complete clock-phase pattern repeats after 5,005 half-beat steps; each export is a sixteen-bar composition through that larger pattern.
seeds: The orbital clock period describes rhythm phase, not 5,005 different songs. Sound, harmony and seed choices create additional variations.
